segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מִי שֶׁאָמַר בִּשְׁעַת מִיתָתוֹ ״יֵשׁ לִי בָּנִים״ – נֶאֱמָן. ״יֵשׁ לִי אַחִים״ – אֵינוֹ נֶאֱמָן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who said at the time of his death: I have children,» in which case his wife does not require levirate marriage after his death, he is «deemed credible.» But if he said on his deathbed: «I have brothers,» indicating that it is prohibited for her to marry anyone else until one of his brothers performs ḥalitza with her after his death, he is «not deemed credible.»

moves.summary: credible about children, not about brothers

positions.claim: credible to say he has children (exempting from levirate), not that he has brothers

unresolved.issue: packet division is 'gemara' but the single segment is a mishna
